opening.argument: The presentation promotes putting Bitcoin into MTI with the claim that it can triple passively within one year, while maintaining $200 in a trading pool supposedly produces Bitcoin daily. Participation is tied to an automated trading bot and team-building through Bitcoin-denominated team sections, with binary pay expressly linked to building the weaker team leg. These passive-return claims support finding a scam built around automated trading and pooled funds. The speaker's assurances of legitimacy do not independently verify the promised returns or the underlying trading and pool activity.
